title: Once India’s Pride…Now Forgotten!💔 The Untold Story of Kinetic Motors | Rise & Fall | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "Once India’s Pride…Now Forgotten!💔 The Untold Story of Kinetic Motors | Rise & Fall | Live Hindi"

Once upon a time, Kinetic Motors was more than just a scooter brand — it was an emotion for millions of Indian families. In this video, we explore the complete rise and fall story of Kinetic, a company that changed India’s two-wheeler industry forever.

From its iconic partnership with Honda to the legendary Kinetic Honda scooter that ruled the 90s, this story reveals how a small Indian company became a household name — and how it eventually lost the race it started.

In this business case study, we’ll uncover:

How Kinetic Honda became the symbol of middle-class India.

Why Hero Honda and Bajaj emerged as stronger competitors.

The strategic mistakes and leadership challenges that led to Kinetic’s downfall.

How Mahindra’s acquisition of Kinetic Motors tried — but failed — to revive the brand.

And what entrepreneurs can learn from the failure of Kinetic Motors.

This is not just about scooters — it’s about innovation, ambition, competition, and the changing face of India’s automobile market.

If you love Indian business stories, brand case studies, and nostalgic tales from the 80s and 90s, you’ll definitely enjoy this deep dive.
